text_nodes.text: The load went to the wind

Soluna announced on October 21st a deal with Applied Digital for a 50 MW AI data center beside the Briscoe Wind Farm near Silverton. Closing depends in part on a tax abatement in Briscoe County. Drawn to illustrate.
Soluna bought the land in August for Dorothy 3, its planned AI campus. The square is 397 acres at the map's own scale. Its place on the map is drawn to illustrate.

text_nodes.text: Soluna describes Project Dorothy as 100 MW built behind the meter at the 150 MW wind farm. In September it said 98 MW was energized. Its chief executive says Soluna was built "to bring load to the generation". One bay stands for 10 MW. Drawn to illustrate.

text_nodes.text: Soluna says the wind farm's substation sits directly across from the land it bought. It says that positions Dorothy 3 for behind the meter access to generation it owns outright. The substation, road and pasture are drawn to illustrate.

text_nodes.text: The plan is twice the wind
Soluna describes Dorothy 3 as up to 300 MW and the wind farm beside it as 150 MW. Each section stands for 10 MW, a drawing unit. Drawn to illustrate.

console_errors: TXT: SKY IN FRAME [r1]. A verdict, not a defect: this snapshot shows its sky

text_nodes.text: Phase 1 of Dorothy 3 is the 50 MW in the deal. Soluna expects it to draw power from both Briscoe Wind and the grid, subject to definitive documentation. Each stake stands for a fifth of it, a drawing unit. Drawn to illustrate.

The 397 acres exceed the 300 acres Soluna first identified for the campus. Soluna says the extra 97 acres leave room to add data halls if more generation or storage becomes available. Squares are drawn to area, not the parcel's shape.

text_nodes.text: A letter of intent, not a lease

After closing Soluna expects Applied to hold 51% and itself 49%. ChronoScale is majority owned by Applied. ChronoScale has signed a non-binding letter of intent to lease. Soluna says a lease may not follow. It expects closing by year end. Drawn to illustrate.

text_nodes.text: Closing depends in part on approval of a tax abatement for the project in Briscoe County. The county posts its tax abatement guidelines beside its Commissioners Court agendas. The courthouse is drawn to illustrate a county seat.
